description: f16 [2, 4096]: f16 rows of 4096 values in [0.5, 1): the sums (~3070) pass 2^11, where an f16 accumulator stops growing (the spacing is 2 there).
reference: torch.sum(x, dim, keepdim) in f64, rounded once to f16
notes: out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator). f16/bf16 accumulate in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8).
